That was also part of the reason I smoked. 

On the drive over beforehand, I was surprised with how little urges I had. I had more urges to "Drink Poison" as I've been saying about alcohol than I did about smoking. But the opportunity presented itself and I took it. AND I DIDN'T DRINK! :) I am very proud of myself for that clarity at least. I didn't kill any neurons or attack my body with ethanol, which is excellent. 

Overall the experience was helpful, not harmful. I stayed engaged at the party and shared plenty of love with my beautiful family. I took Lucy in the woods when I got home and I journaled and pulled tarot (the Knight of Wands when last night I pulled the Devil). The Devil is not marijuana. The Devil is the strings pulling me to judge and expect perfection and feed constant Automatic Negative Thoughts without relenting. It's the self-hate and constant stream of thoughts that tell me I am not good enough and making mistakes and it was wrong to say that or I was bad for doing this. The weed slows those thoughts and helps me recognize them. It doesn't work for long term use, but it helps when the noise is loud and helps me compare the two worlds I can live in. This world (the world I want to be in) exists through meditation, movement, nature, companionship, thoughtfulness, learning, understanding, patience, kindness, compassion, and love. Find the radical acceptance for simply existing. I love you so fucking much babe.
